findings.source: Leper: Сейчас организовалась настоящая охота на ведьм.
findings.currentTarget: Leper: Sasa umeanza uwindaji wa wachawi wa kweli.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Leper: Sasa umeanza uwindaji halisi wa wachawi.
findings.objectiveReason: настоящая modifies witch hunt, a persecution metaphor. wa kweli currently modifies wachawi, asserting real witches. The next line describes anyone unusual becoming suspected; preserve the metaphor and modify the hunt.

findings.source: Experienced: Я, может, и сидел за грабёж, но никого не мочил.
findings.currentTarget: Experienced: Labda nilifungwa kwa wizi wa kutumia nguvu, lakini sijawahi kumuua mtu.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Experienced: Hata kama nilifungwa kwa wizi wa kutumia nguvu, sijawahi kumuua mtu.
findings.objectiveReason: может, и is concessive here: he acknowledges his robbery imprisonment but denies killing. Labda means perhaps and changes the acknowledged criminal history into an uncertain claim.
